runtimeSettings.title: Runtime Settings
runtimeSettings.description: Configure the global concurrency value used by session queue scheduling.
runtimeSettings.loadErrorDescription: Try again before editing this setting.

maxConcurrentSessions.label: Max concurrent sessions
maxConcurrentSessions.helper: Leave blank for unlimited sessions. Set 1 for local LLM setups that can only run one session at a time.
maxConcurrentSessions.invalid: Enter a whole number greater than 0, or leave blank for none.

harnessesPanel.defaultModelDescription: Used when new sessions start without an explicit Harness or model. Its run options below apply to every session of this Harness.

betaFeatures.title: Beta features
betaFeatures.description: Try beta features. This setting applies to every project and dashboard connected to this installation.

developerTools.title: Developer tools
developerTools.description: Tools for checking how this app runs. These settings are saved on this device only.

paused.title: {{name}} is paused
paused.body: Paused from the performance monitor. Its views stay unloaded until you resume.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.openRelatedResourcesHelper: Automatically open a recent related resource of each kind as an unpinned preview.

updates.title: Update channel
updates.description: Choose which builds this app updates to. The setting applies to this device only.
updates.nightlyHelper: A signed build of the latest main branch, published once a day. It may have bugs and runs new database migrations on your data.
updates.switchBackNote: Switching back to Stable keeps this version until a newer stable release is out.
updates.saveError: Could not change the update channel.
